text:
Nora: quick note from the multi-region smoke test: when we ramped failover for eu-west-1->us-east-1 a subset of tenants with consent flags flipped unexpectedly. we need a consent-token pattern and clearer operator semantics before doing any auto-swap.
Felix: can you describe flipped? did consent flags change in control plane or were they stale reads?
Nora: control plane saw 'consent=true' in the replica because of eventual sync lag; the authoritative store still had consent=false. result: an attempted cross-border swap kicked off. logs: ```
[7080001235] tenant=acct-900 consent_seen=replica:true authoritative:false
[7080001236] swap-queued tenant=acct-900 reason=auto-rebalance
[7080001237] swap-abort tenant=acct-900 reason=consent-mismatch
```
Marta: painful. we should require a short-lived consent-token issued by the authoritative region for any auto-move. tokens must be signed and include expiry and intent (read-only/read-write).
Rajat: agree. also a separate class of "consent-binding": if tenant has PII_jurisdiction tag -> auto-move blocked regardless of token. tokens only for consented non-PII tenants.
Felix: ops impact: token handshake adds one RPC but avoids mistaken swaps. token flow: authoritative CP issues token via `/v1/consent-tokens` signed by KMS, target region validates token before acting. token TTL=120s default.
Nora: proposal:
- consent-token required for any auto-swap that crosses data-jurisdiction flag
- token shape: `{tenant, action, issued_by, exp, signature, kms_key_id}`
- token-checkpoint: controlplane persists token issuance event and emits `consent.token.issued` metric
- fallback: if token can't be validated -> abort and surface `swap.status=blocked_consent`
Felix: add safety valves: limit auto-swap retries to 2 per tenant per hour, and require manual review after third attempt. include `swap.attempts` telemetry.
Marta: model promotion nuance: when swapping we also may need to promote a quantized model variant in target region. require model-tag agreement in token or else block. token.intent can include `model_tag: q4_0` to assert compatibility.
Rajat: runtime guard: if prewarm latency > 500ms for priming, pause further swaps in that batch. batch-level throttle should be observable as `swap.batch.paused`.
ops-bot: :rotating_light: attempted-swap blocked for acct-900 at 7080001237 (reason=consent-mismatch)
Nora: API surfaces to add: `POST /v1/consent-tokens {tenant, action, model_tag?}` returns `{token, issued_at, expires_at}`; `GET /v1/swap-status?batch_id=`; bulk `POST /v1/swap-batches` should accept `require_consent_token=true` flag.
Felix: tests: sim delayed CP replication + token issuance races + model-tag mismatch. assert blocked swap emits `swap.blocked_reason=consent_token_missing` and does not prewarm.
Marta: UX: console show "Consent token required" banner on tenant page when jurisdiction flags set. add audit trail of token issuances with who/why.
Rajat: cost guard: estimate additional cross-region model-load cost before swapping; if estimate > 12% of region spare budget abort auto-swap and escalate. document this in RFC.
Nora: I'll fold into RFC follow-up: consent-token handshake, token API shape, batch guard metrics, and runbook snippet for manual token issuance when legal approves. ping for review when ready.
Marta: :thumbsup: will review token format and KMS details.
Felix: :ok_hand: I'll add the test harness for the replication lag scenario.
